- 1.4 million+ international patients choose India for medical care annually

- Average cost saving: 70-80% vs USA, UK or Europe

## Medical Treatment Costs: India vs USA

| Procedure | India Cost | USA Cost | Saving |
|-----------|-----------|----------|--------|
| Bypass Surgery (CABG) | $4,500–$7,000 | $80,000–$120,000 | ~93% |
| Knee Replacement | $5,000–$8,500 | $35,000–$70,000 | ~86% |
| Hip Replacement | $5,500–$9,000 | $35,000–$65,000 | ~85% |
| Brain Tumour Surgery | $7,000–$16,000 | $70,000–$200,000 | ~90% |
| Kidney Transplant | $12,000–$20,000 | $150,000–$300,000 | ~92% |
| Liver Transplant | $25,000–$45,000 | $300,000–$600,000 | ~91% |
| Cancer Treatment | $6,000–$14,000 | $60,000–$150,000 | ~90% |
| IVF (per cycle) | $2,500–$5,500 | $15,000–$30,000 | ~83% |
| Cataract Surgery | $400–$1,200/eye | $4,000–$7,000/eye | ~85% |
| Dental Implants | $500–$1,200 | $3,000–$5,000 | ~80% |
| LASIK Eye Surgery | $600–$1,000 | $4,000–$5,000 | ~83% |
| Spine Surgery | $4,500–$10,000 | $50,000–$120,000 | ~91% |

3. Narayana Health — Bengaluru, Kolkata (NABH, world's highest cardiac volume)
4. Tata Memorial Centre — Mumbai (WHO Collaborating Centre, best cancer hospital)
5. Fortis Healthcare — Pan India (JCI Accredited, 36 hospitals)
6. AIIMS Delhi — Government, India's finest surgeons
7. CMC Vellore — Best for kidney transplants
8. NIMHANS — Bengaluru, best for neurology and brain surgery
9. Escorts Heart Institute — New Delhi, best for cardiac surgery
10. Kokilaben Hospital — Mumbai, JCI Accredited
11. Nova IVF Fertility — Pan India, best for IVF treatment
12. Aravind Eye Care — Madurai, world's highest volume eye hospital

## Accreditations at Partner Hospitals
- JCI (Joint Commission International) — same standard as US hospitals
- NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals)
- WHO (World Health Organisation)
- NABL (National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories)
- ISO 9001:2015

## How to Get Indian Medical Visa
1. Apply online at indianvisaonline.gov.in (select "Medical" category)
2. Documents: hospital invitation letter, medical reports, passport (6+ months validity)
3. Processing: 3-5 business days, fee ~$25
4. Validity: 60 days, extendable for ongoing treatment
5. MedYatra prepares your hospital invitation letter (included in $40 Premium Plan)
